title: PersonaMix Solo #22 (솔로 · 옻칠=경국지색 · 옻칠 금분 · 앵글 극단 로우앵글 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Japanese · 메이크업 잉크 블랙립(포인트) · 배경 호텔 로비 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, late 20s, a legendary Eastern beauty said to topple nations, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long straight jet-black hair — full body glossy gold-flecked urushi lacquer fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid lacquered curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted lacquer sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING warm gold-flecked lacquer across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID deep red lacquer lines and scattered gold dust between the sections, with tiny inlaid gemstones set along the joints, mirror-gloss lacquered, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: leaning against a pillar with one arm resting on it, one knee bent — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of the same lacquer, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT lacquer — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a bright luxury hotel lobby with a polished pale marble floor, a standard-height entrance door, a curved staircase and a long reception counter, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length EXTREME worm's-eye view shot with the camera placed on the floor at boot level and tilted steeply upward, the towering heels and boots huge in the foreground, her legs rising in exaggerated perspective and her head far above at the top of the frame, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
